Ollie, a startup whose mission was to deliver an AI assistant that respected its users’ privacy, says that it will be shutting down in a week. Bill Lennon, the company’s co-founder and CEO, took to X on Friday to deliver the news, noting that the app will officially shut down on November 6.

“I’m really proud of what we accomplished,” Lennon said. “We built an incredible personal assistant with a small team, and learned a ton. I’m grateful to our amazing team, our users, our investors, and everyone who supported us on this journey.”
The text-based AI assistant market has exploded over the past year, as the increasingly powerful models that undergird such applications have made them significantly more useful for daily tasks.

Ollie, which discussed its $7.5 million seed round led from Khosla Ventures with TechCrunch in September, offered a subscription-based model. The assistant was focused on helping families stay connected and organized. The app connected to a user’s email and calendar, while also providing integrated functions to help with appointment bookings, meal planning, and bill payments. The company had also planned to eventually move into household budgeting.

Crucially, Ollie was one of the first mainstream apps that managed to achieve SOC 2, a privacy compliance standard that companies can attain via an independent audit. Unfortunately, user privacy has never been a hugely profitable aspect of the tech industry. If anything, many new digital assistants present unique privacy challenges for their users — as companies like Instinct have shown.

Ultimately, the pressures of the burgeoning AI industry had taken its toll on the company, Lennon said. “We got close, but ultimately couldn’t keep up,” he added. “With Muse, Instinct, and others entering the space, it became harder to stand out, grow, and raise the capital we needed to succeed.”
Ollie’s customers will receive instructions on how to export data and receive refunds in the coming days, Lennon added.

Ollie 是一家初创公司，其使命是提供尊重用户隐私的人工智能助手，该公司表示将在一周内关闭。该公司联合创始人兼首席执行官比尔·列侬 (Bill Lennon) 周五在 X 上发布了这一消息，并指出该应用将于 11 月 6 日正式关闭。
“我对我们所取得的成就感到非常自豪，”列侬说。 “我们用一个小团队打造了一个令人难以置信的个人助理，并学到了很多东西。我感谢我们出色的团队、我们的用户、我们的投资者以及在这段旅程中支持我们的每个人。”
基于文本的人工智能助手市场在过去一年中呈爆炸式增长，因为支撑此类应用程序的模型日益强大，使其对日常任务更加有用。
Ollie 在 9 月份与 TechCrunch 讨论了由 Khosla Ventures 领投的 750 万美元种子轮融资，并提供了基于订阅的模式。该助理专注于帮助家庭保持联系和组织有序。该应用程序连接到用户的电子邮件和日历，同时还提供集成功能来帮助预约、膳食计划和账单支付。该公司还计划最终进入家庭预算领域。
至关重要的是，Ollie 是首批成功实现 SOC 2 的主流应用程序之一，SOC 2 是公司可以通过独立审核达到的隐私合规标准。不幸的是，用户隐私从来都不是科技行业利润丰厚的方面。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是许多新的数字助理给用户带来了独特的隐私挑战——正如 Instinct 等公司所表明的那样。
列侬表示，最终，蓬勃发展的人工智能行业的压力给该公司带来了损失。 “我们已经接近了，但最终没能跟上，”他补充道。 “随着 Muse、Instinct 和其他公司进入这个领域，脱颖而出、成长和筹集成功所需的资金变得更加困难。”
列侬补充说，奥利的客户将在未来几天内收到有关如何导出数据和获得退款的说明。

Intel’s stock suffered one of its worst days ever on Friday, crashing around 28% after the chip giant reported a weaker-than-expected outlook for the fourth quarter.

This rout reduced the value of Intel’s holdings by the government by $12 billion, CNBC reports. The Trump administration had the government buy 10% stake over a year ago. Nvidia, which also took a big stake in Intel in 2025, saw its stock drop a bit on Friday as well. Much of the tech industry — especially chipmakers — were caught in the sell-off.

Intel’s stock is still a profitable investment for the government so far (and for Nvidia), as it’s up more than 70% for the year, even if it’s dropped significantly from the sky-high prices it commanded over the summer.

The scare-off was caused when Intel warned to expect revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion in the fourth quarter when analysts were looking for around $17 billion. It also warned that its gross profit margin would decline to 37% from 43%, and it was investing so heavily, it expected no positive cash flow.
The main problem for Intel is that PC sales are being hurt by the AI industry gobbling memory and other components, and causing PC prices to rise.

“Our customers began signaling a PC slowdown based on the memory prices and availability. Year-to-date system endpoint prices have increased significantly, placing additional pressure on already limited IT budgets,” Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan warned on the call.

The bright side is that revenue from Intel’s data center business grew 78% over the year-ago quarter. But it is hamstrung on that front until it can bring more capacity to its fabs and book more external customers for them, competing with powerhouse Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. One of Intel’s new fabs in Arizona is operational but the next one isn’t expected to be online until 2028.

芯片巨头英特尔公布第四季度前景弱于预期后，周五该股遭遇有史以来最糟糕的日子之一，暴跌约 28%。
据 CNBC 报道，这次溃败使政府持有的英特尔股份价值减少了 120 亿美元。一年前，特朗普政府要求政府购买 10% 的股份。英伟达 (Nvidia) 也在 2025 年入股了英特尔 (Intel) 的大量股份，周五其股价也小幅下跌。许多科技行业——尤其是芯片制造商——都陷入了抛售之中。
到目前为止，英特尔的股票对于政府（以及英伟达）来说仍然是一项有利可图的投资，因为今年以来该股上涨了 70% 以上，尽管该股较夏季的天价大幅下跌。
英特尔警告称，预计第四季度营收将达到 150 亿至 160 亿美元，而分析师的预期为 170 亿美元左右，引发了恐慌。它还警告称，其毛利率将从43%下降至37%，而且其投资如此之大，预计不会出现正现金流。
英特尔面临的主要问题是，人工智能行业吞噬内存和其他组件，导致个人电脑销售受到影响，并导致个人电脑价格上涨。
英特尔首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 在电话会议上警告称：“我们的客户开始根据内存价格和可用性发出 PC 放缓的信号。今年迄今为止，系统端点价格已大幅上涨，给本已有限的 IT 预算带来了额外的压力。”
好的一面是，英特尔数据中心业务的收入比去年同期增长了 78%。但它在这方面受到了阻碍，直到它能够为其晶圆厂带来更多产能并为其预订更多外部客户，与实力雄厚的台积电竞争。英特尔在亚利桑那州的一座新晶圆厂已投入运营，但下一座预计要到 2028 年才会投产。

It happens to the best of us — you’ve completely dropped the ball on figuring out a Halloween costume. Naturally, you’ve decided to solve this problem by turning to… TechCrunch? Yeah, sure, why not. I’ve got some ideas.
Here are some last-minute techy Halloween costumes. Effort levels vary.

AI leaders like Dario Amodei and Sam Altman have expressed their fears that AI is developing too quickly, but if AI models become capable of “recursive self-improvement,” they’ll be able to advance on their own without human intervention, rendering any efforts to “pace the frontier” futile.

I’m not sure how to visually represent the idea of an AI building itself, but you could really lean into the “self-improvement” part and forget the “recursive” aspect — it’s a last-minute Halloween costume. You don’t need to try that hard.

Dress as the version of yourself you imagine becoming every year when you make New Year’s resolutions. Carry around a self-help or productivity book like “Atomic Habits” or anything by Malcolm Gladwell, a yoga mat, and a huge bottle of water. Leave in the middle of the party to “go to therapy” when you actually just want to go home. Brag to people about how good your Oura Ring’s sleep score is.
You are the embodiment of someone trying to better themselves. You are recursive self-improvement.

Meta and OpenAI both recently launched AI assistants with creepily cute avatars. It’s almost Elizabeth Holmes-esque — they look innocent, so you underestimate their potential to cause disaster. (While we’re talking about her, you’re only allowed to do the black turtleneck Holmes costume if you’re a natural blonde, or if you have a blonde wig.)

What you’re going to do is make yourself look big and fluffy. Maybe you have a poofy puffer jacket, or maybe you can find some colorful feather boas to wrap yourself in. Add a distinctive hat, glasses, or other accessory to make yourself look more like a ChatGPT dot. If you have a colorful shirt and matching bottoms, that also works.
Throughout the night, ask people if you can obtain read/write access to their Gmail.

Whether you call them “pervert glasses” or not, we should all be able to agree that it would be really spooky if someone just started recording you without your consent — perfectly in keeping with the Halloween spirit.

Just grab a pair of glasses — or buy a cheap pair somewhere convenient — and attach a big red or white circle to one lens, mimicking the red recording light. If you want to make the costume extra creepy (or, if you can’t make a big circle sticker), you can just wear normal glasses and say that you’re “guy recording with the light covered up.” Please, just don’t actually record people without their consent while you wear this costume.
While we’re at it, Mark Zuckerberg’s fashion has been pretty recognizable lately. He’s been wearing a lot of slightly oversized, boxy black T-shirts.
It may be hard to replicate the black-text-on-black-shirt style he gravitates toward, but you could attach a piece of paper to yourself that says “Building is my love language.”

If you feel confident in your Latin pronunciation, you could go for something actually scary, like the time he wore a shirt that said “Aut Zuck aut nihil,” which means “Either Zuck or nothing.” It’s a little ominous.
For some people, there’s nothing scarier than running out of Claude tokens.

Grab a piece of cardboard, print out screenshots of notifications telling you that you’ve reached your usage limit, and go spook some vibe-coders. I’ve illustrated this idea using an edited stock photo. You don’t have to dress like you work at Hot Topic — that’s just the model in the image.

The scary PHP-ocalypse is fresh in our memory — it was only last week that AI unearthed critical PHP flaws that could’ve been catastrophic for the internet. The fear that web developers felt is still palpable, making it a good Halloween costume: You are a PHP vulnerability.
Here’s what you’re going to do. Buy a T-shirt and a sharpie, and write PHP on it. Keep it simple.

What about the vulnerability part? You’re going to have to commit to the bit. All night, you’re going to talk to your friends about your feelings. Actually bare your emotions. Talk about how your recent loss of a loved one made you remember how fragile life can be. If making yourself vulnerable kills the vibe, just pretend it was part of the Halloween costume and that you’re really cool and fun and never feel sad ever.
The costume explains itself.
Couples costume alert!

Maybe you have more than one Halloween party to go to this weekend, but you want your various costumes to stick to a specific theme. Once you’ve got your sleepy time getup sorted, it’s time to prep your second costume portraying the controversial biohacker: GLP-Bryan.

Johnson wrote on X earlier this year: “I frequently lay on top of Kate with all of my bodyweight. The deep pressure calms her nervous system, quiets racing thoughts, and releases oxytocin which lowers cortisol. We call it GLP-Bryan.”
Naturally, people were confused, so he shared an image to demonstrate.

Yes, this will be hard to reproduce as a Halloween costume, but if you’ve run out of time to buy anything, this one will do. Just wear a T-shirt and jeans, which you probably already own. It will be weird to lie on top of your partner in the middle of a party. Really weird. But that’s what you get for waiting until now to figure out a costume.

我们中最优秀的人都会遇到这种情况——你在设计万圣节服装时完全失败了。当然，您决定通过求助于……TechCrunch 来解决这个问题？是的，当然，为什么不呢。我有一些想法。
这里有一些最后一刻的高科技万圣节服装。努力程度各不相同。
达里奥·阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）和山姆·奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）等人工智能领导者表达了他们对人工智能发展太快的担忧，但如果人工智能模型能够“递归自我改进”，它们将能够在没有人类干预的情况下自行进步，从而使任何“开拓前沿”的努力都是徒劳的。
我不确定如何直观地表达人工智能构建本身的想法，但你确实可以专注于“自我完善”部分，而忘记“递归”方面——这是最后一刻的万圣节服装。你不需要那么努力。
当你每年制定新年计划时，打扮成你想象中的自己。随身携带一本自助或生产力书籍，例如《原子习惯》或马尔科姆·格拉德威尔（Malcolm Gladwell）写的任何书籍、瑜伽垫和一大瓶水。当你实际上只想回家时，请在聚会中途离开去“接受治疗”。向人们吹嘘您的 Oura Ring 睡眠得分有多好。
你是一个努力让自己变得更好的人的化身。你是递归的自我完善。
Meta 和 OpenAI 最近都推出了带有令人毛骨悚然的可爱头像的人工智能助手。这几乎是伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯式的——他们看起来很无辜，所以你低估了他们造成灾难的潜力。 （当我们谈论她时，只有当你是天生的金发女郎，或者你有一顶金色假发时，你才可以穿黑色高领福尔摩斯服装。）
你要做的就是让自己看起来又大又蓬松。也许您有一件蓬松的羽绒服，或者您可以找到一些色彩缤纷的羽毛围巾来包裹自己。添加一顶独特的帽子、眼镜或其他配饰，让自己看起来更像 ChatGPT 圆点。如果您有一件彩色衬衫和配套的下装，也可以。
整个晚上，询问人们是否可以获得他们 Gmail 的读/写权限。
无论你是否称它们为“变态眼镜”，我们都应该能够同意，如果有人在未经你同意的情况下开始对你进行录音，那将是非常令人毛骨悚然的——这完全符合万圣节的精神。
只需拿起一副眼镜——或者在方便的地方买一副便宜的眼镜——然后在一个镜片上贴上一个红色或白色的大圆圈，模仿红色的录音灯。如果你想让服装变得更加令人毛骨悚然（或者，如果你不能制作一个大圆圈贴纸），你可以戴上普通眼镜并说你是“用遮住灯光录制的人”。拜托，当你穿着这套服装时，不要在未经他们同意的情况下实际拍摄他们。
就在我们讨论这个话题的时候，马克·扎克伯格的时尚最近已经相当知名了。他穿了很多略显大号、四四方方的黑色 T 恤。
也许很难复制他喜欢的黑衬衫黑字风格，但你可以在自己身上贴一张纸，上面写着“建筑是我的爱的语言”。
如果你对自己的拉丁语发音有信心，你可以选择一些真正可怕的东西，比如他穿着一件衬衫，上面写着“Aut Zuck aut nihil”，意思是“要么扎克，要么什么都没有”。这有点不祥。
对于某些人来说，没有什么比用完克劳德代币更可怕的了。
抓起一块纸板，打印出通知的屏幕截图，告诉您已达到使用限制，然后去吓唬一些振动编码员。我用一张经过编辑的库存照片来说明这个想法。你不必穿得像在 Hot Topic 工作的那样——这只是图中的模特。
可怕的 PHP 灾难我们还记忆犹新——就在上周，人工智能才发现了 PHP 的关键缺陷，这些缺陷可能会给互联网带来灾难性的后果。 Web 开发人员感受到的恐惧仍然显而易见，这使它成为一套很好的万圣节服装：你是一个 PHP 漏洞。
这就是你要做的事情。买一件T恤和一把记号笔，在上面写上PHP。保持简单。
那么漏洞部分呢？你必须全身心投入。整个晚上，你都会和你的朋友谈论你的感受。其实就是把自己的情绪都流露出来。谈谈您最近失去亲人如何让您想起生命是多么脆弱。如果让自己变得脆弱会破坏气氛，那就假装这是万圣节服装的一部分，假装你真的很酷、很有趣，永远不会感到悲伤。
服装本身就说明了一切。
情侣装注意事项！
也许这个周末你有不止一个万圣节派对要去参加，但你希望你的各种服装都符合特定的主题。一旦你安排好睡觉时间的起床时间，就可以准备你的第二套服装来扮演备受争议的生物黑客：GLP-Bryan。
约翰逊今年早些时候在 X 上写道：“我经常用我的全部体重压在凯特身上。深层压力可以让她的神经系统平静下来，平息急躁的思绪，并释放催产素，从而降低皮质醇。我们称之为 GLP-Bryan。”
当然，人们很困惑，所以他分享了一张图片来演示。
是的，这很难复制为万圣节服装，但如果你没有时间买任何东西，这个就可以了。只需穿一件您可能已经拥有的 T 恤和牛仔裤即可。在聚会中躺在你的伴侣身上会很奇怪。真的很奇怪。但这就是你等到现在才想出一套服装所得到的结果。

fulltext: As OpenAI’s buying spree squeezes the world’s supply of RAM, its CEO explains why he needs so much.﻿

Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it’s “terrible” to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI’s impact on math, Altman said:

“A lot of people want local inference. And somehow, they assume that the problem is solved now because we are going to have open-source models, we’re going to be able to run them on our computers, and so we’re not going to need all the stuff in the data center.

But from a global allocation perspective, actually, it’s quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world’s limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used five percent of the time.
You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you’re trying to deal with this very supply constrained environment. And somehow everyone’s— many people’s intuition is the opposite of that.”

Whether Altman meant your gaming PC or developers working with something like the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box or the new touchscreen MacBook Pro, the outcome is the same. Right now, memory companies Samsung and SK Hynix have long term deals with cloud service operators and projects like OpenAI’s Stargate that have reserved much of the world’s RAM output over the next few years. And the billions they’re willing to lay out for chips is why the laptops, phones, and other tech you use are getting more expensive right now.

cards.title: nemotron-halloween
fulltext: Or rather…

TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D, and he runs on a single workstation.

I wanted the kids visiting my house at Halloween to interact in a fun and unique way. The house was going to be in charge and giving out the treats, but more grumpy than scary. Somehow, my solution was to give the garage door a mouth and teach him to complain.

That became MonsterHouse: a grumpy old building with pirate stories, a fiery grin and a suspicious weakness for “please.” NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent supplies the conversation foundation. Nemotron Speech does the listening, Bolt E4B is the brain, NVIDIA Magpie TTS Zeroshot is the live voice, and NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D makes the wooden mouth talk.

The mouth came first. I imagined the wooden garage door boards splitting into jagged lips, with the burning flames of hell illuminating the driveway from beyond whenever he opened his cursed mouth. He needed to look ancient, expressive and mildly offended by the existence of visitors.
A few expressions from a house with plenty to say.

Creating a custom animation rig was one of the more labor intensive parts of the build. After bashing it into submission, I could export the facial expression shapes that Audio2Face-3D could later animate. The character SkelMesh was built in Autodesk Maya then exported into Unreal Engine where virtual fire and effects were added behind the door. With no eyes, no eyebrows and no blinking, he’s a surprisingly economical monster.

While all the nonsense of building the character was going on, NVIDIA built the Nemotron Voice Agent. What was supposed to be the hard part of the build now became rather fun, iterative and easy. I had a foundation for listening, conversation and speech right out of the box. The house already had a mouth. Now he could finally find something to complain about.

The house needed a past as cantankerous as its personality so I devised a backstory that the house had been built from the timbers of a sunken pirate ship, haunted by its stormy past. The nautical complaints now had a reason. This was the ship, reincarnated as real estate and not entirely pleased about it.

The performance needed a guide, a path to follow from greeting to goodbye while providing treats along the way. First, the house would brush visitors off with remarks like “I’m busy grumbling, go bother the neighbors!” But persistence would wear him down. A “Please” could break through immediately, and “thank you” earned a warm farewell. Once a visitor won him over, I wanted him to stay won over. Nobody wants to negotiate with the same garage door twice.
Here is where the Voice Agent really shines. You can choose any LLM you like. Because I wanted the system to be off-grid and completely self-contained, I had a memory and compute budget.

The character needs more than a prompt that says “be grumpy.” It had to follow a master conversation flow, respond to what visitors actually said, track encounter state, and leave enough compute for the rest of the pipeline.

After testing more than a dozen models, I landed on Bolt E4B to supply the live dialogue. It is an open small language model purpose-built for local conversational agents and interactive characters, which is a fair description of a talking garage door. I use the 4-bit quantized release (the “4GB” in its name) as the default response model, with the BF16 checkpoint available for comparison.

If it’s not obvious by now, I work at NVIDIA and due to this I was able to test Bolt E4B before its public release and found it to be a solid choice, with a smaller footprint than other frontrunners- Qwen3 30B-A3B and Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B.
It works inside the Nemotron Voice Agent pipeline, turning what visitors say into the next suitably reluctant reply.
Bolt provides the conversational foundation. My prompts, application logic and LoRA adapter trained on thousands of reviewed example conversations shape it into this particular stubborn ship.

Creating a dataset of over 5000 multi-turn conversations meant I could train LoRAs for each model I felt good enough to be an option. Some took about an hour to train, some took a couple. A local agent ran everything and benchmarked the results. That agent and a very large LLM created and judged the dataset to begin with. This happened at night or while I was doing the day job.

With the LoRA in place I check the replies for continuity, timing and tone, benchmark models and adapters for quality, repetition and speed, and then listen to the performance. The house should give in eventually, without turning into a cheerful concierge. A little resistance is part of the charm. An endless argument with a garage door is not.
Two shortcuts, two outputs. Authored text skips fresh dialogue generation, and saved audio skips synthesis. Clean speech drives the animation separately from the audience effects.

A haunted house loses authority if he takes too long to complain. The pipeline releases speakable text before an entire answer is finished, so the house can start talking while the rest of the sentence is still on its way. Prepared greetings and candy jokes cover familiar encounters: the text bank saves language-model work, and cached recordings save speech synthesis. Even an ancient grump benefits from rehearsing.

NVIDIA Magpie TTS Zeroshot turns text into the Queen’s English. Its zero-shot voice conditioning uses a short reference sample instead of a trained voice; mine supplies the grumpy pirate character. The house has seven moods, from grumpy and menacing to amused and delighted, and emotion tags dictated by the prompt template and provided by the LLM choose how each line is delivered. Since each emotion requires a different 3-10 second voice sample I added a “Sample your Voice” block on the UI’s tool tab. I could then read and record a sample line of text in my best happy pirate or angry pirate voice. When it’s “Go” time, Bolt E4B decides what to say, and Magpie turns that text into speech with the proper delight or despair.

Next down the pipe is Audio2Face-3D and the 3d character scene I created in Epic’s Unreal Engine. The default model weights work best with a clean neutral male or female voice, not too deep, not too high (choose the appropriate gendered model for your use case). I wanted the house to have a very deep and demonic voice with echo and chamber. In this case, since my voice samples don’t have that theatrical heft, it’s actually a benefit. Audio2Face-3D gets clean speech from the samples and a second audio stream adds adjustable real-time vocal effects that play out the speakers.

To keep everything running smoothly, I split the work to a pair of GPUs: the language and voice model pipeline runs on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q, and Unreal Engine graphics with Audio2Face-3D runs on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell. Memory isn’t the issue, compute is. I want to keep animation at a consistent frame rate regardless of what processing the agent pipeline is doing.

Voice, animation and effects have to land together. A convincing monster needs more than a fast answer; it needs to sound as though the complaint belongs to the building. In my case, he does. Tweaks to sync audio delivery are available. I’ve found I could set them and forget them. (100ms compensates for the Audio2Face-3D buffering)

Somewhere along the way, “make the house talk” required an interface full of controls. I can audition cached lines, adjust the opening mood, follow the conversation, change the voice treatment and tune the mouth animation. Tabs cover conversations, model selection, recordings, prompts, performance monitoring and camera feeds, and a soundboard and custom dialogue field let me put words in his mouth. There are also model-loading controls and an Unreal Engine connection indicator, because sometimes the monster is not sulking. He is disconnected.
The MonsterHouse control desk, with the soundboard, custom lines, opening mood and conversation flow.

The fire and glow have joined the act. Editable rules tie visual cues to delivery: live cues begin with speech, while recorded performances can follow a saved timeline. I can direct a change of mood without rebuilding the scene.

Live mode runs the trick-or-treat character. Demo mode persuades The house to explain himself. Microphone mode lets me speak through the house directly, bypassing recognition, dialogue generation and speech synthesis. My clean voice drives the mouth; the audience hears the treated version. The house considers this possession. I consider it a useful fallback.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is a VLM that gives the house visual context. As an optional observer, it interprets camera images and describes visible costumes so the character has something specific to react to. Not looking to reinvent every wheel, I chose the popular object detection and tracking models YOLO and ByteTrack to count and track people currently in view. Keeping those jobs separate lets the house notice a group without asking Omni to narrate every frame.

For a suitably ridiculous test, I gave Omni a video of five costumed sheep at the door. Its saved analysis identified the pirate, vampire, witch, pumpkin and ghost outfits. That is the sort of visual context I want the house to use. Apparently even livestock have more elaborate Halloween plans than I do.
Five very woolly trick-or-treaters in a synthetic test replay. Costume labels come from the saved Omni analysis; boxes and track IDs are illustrative.

The sheep are a synthetic test, not evidence of a successful Halloween night. Real driveway groups, costumes and night lighting still need testing. Detection does trigger automatic greetings, but I fear trendy costume identification and suitably witty retorts may need some post training. Since the house has no eyes, he calls his visitor awareness echolocation. I am letting him have that one.

There is more to do: the animation can always improve, complete performance testing needs real visitors, and candy will one day be provided automatically. I have not yet reached the original goal of leaving him to run Halloween while I head off with my family to see the other neighborhood ghouls. But that is still the point of all this. One day a child will meet a grumpy old house, try a little kindness and discover that the old timber has a soft spot. And gives out candy bars.

The MonsterHouse code itself is not packaged for release, but every NVIDIA model it uses is available today, and the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent gets you most of the way. This is the path I would follow.

A cached response bank and saved audio for your most common lines will make even a slow monster feel quick. In fact, if you happen to be limited by computing power, there is no reason why you can’t have a Live version that just uses Nemotron 3 ASR, a python conversation router, with all cached audio. You can use the Bolt E4B and Magpie pipeline to generate 100s of responses offline, then use the cache for the show. I’ll be doing this for the interactive pumpkins.

fulltext_cn: 或者更确切地说……

TL;DR：MonsterHouse 是我为万圣节创建的交互式投影。他听着“不给糖就捣蛋”的游戏，用一艘脾气暴躁的老海盗船的声音回答，当游客记住他们的举止时，他的态度就会软化。他基于 NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent 构建，配备 NVIDIA Nemotron ASR、Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 和 Audio2Face-3D，并且在单个工作站上运行。
我希望孩子们在万圣节期间来到我家，以一种有趣而独特的方式互动。房子将负责并分发零食，但脾气暴躁而不是可怕。不知何故，我的解决办法是给车库门一个嘴，教他抱怨。
这就是怪物屋：一座脾气暴躁的老建筑，充满海盗故事，笑容灿烂，对“请”表示怀疑。 NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent 提供对话基础。 Nemotron Speech 负责聆听，Bolt E4B 负责大脑，NVIDIA Magpie TTS Zeroshot 负责现场语音，NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D 负责木嘴说话。
首先是嘴。我想象着车库的木制门板裂成锯齿状的嘴唇，每当他张开那张该死的嘴时，地狱燃烧的火焰就会从远处照亮车道。他需要看起来古老、富有表现力，并且对访客的存在感到轻微的冒犯。
一些有很多话要说的房子的表情。
创建自定义动画装备是构建中劳动密集型部分之一。在将其提交后，我可以导出 Audio2Face-3D 稍后可以制作动画的面部表情形状。角色 SkelMesh 在 Autodesk Maya 中构建，然后导出到虚幻引擎中，在门后添加虚拟火焰和效果。他没有眼睛，没有眉毛，也不眨眼，是一个令人惊讶的经济怪物。
当构建角色的所有废话都在进行时，NVIDIA 构建了 Nemotron 语音代理。原本应该是构建中最困难的部分现在变得相当有趣、迭代且简单。我已经为倾听、对话和演讲奠定了基础。房子已经有嘴了。现在他终于可以找到可以抱怨的事情了。
这所房子需要一个像它的性格一样脾气暴躁的过去，所以我设计了一个背景故事，说这所房子是用一艘沉没的海盗船的木材建造的，被其暴风雨的过去所困扰。航海方面的抱怨现在有了理由。这就是这艘船，转世为房地产，但对此并不完全满意。
表演需要一个指南，一条从问候到告别的路径，同时提供沿途的款待。首先，房子会用诸如“我正忙着发牢骚，去打扰邻居吧！”之类的话来拒绝访客。但坚持会让他疲惫不堪。一句“请”立刻就能突破，一句“谢谢”就赢得了热烈的告别。一旦有访客赢得了他的青睐，我就希望他能一直被吸引。没有人愿意与同一个车库门谈判两次。
这就是语音代理真正发挥作用的地方。您可以选择任何您喜欢的LLM。因为我希望系统能够脱离电网并且完全独立，所以我有一个内存和计算预算。
这个角色需要的不仅仅是“脾气暴躁”的提示。它必须遵循主对话流程，响应访客实际所说的内容，跟踪遭遇状态，并为管道的其余部分留下足够的计算能力。
在测试了十多个模型之后，我选择了 Bolt E4B 来提供实时对话。它是一个开放的小语言模型，专为本地会话代理和交互角色而构建，这是对会说话的车库门的合理描述。我使用 4 位量化版本（名称中的“4GB”）作为默认响应模型，并使用 BF16 检查点进行比较。
如果现在还不是很明显，我在 NVIDIA 工作，因此我能够在 Bolt E4B 公开发布之前对其进行测试，并发现它是一个可靠的选择，其占用空间比其他领先者 Qwen3 30B-A3B 和 Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B 更小。
它在 Nemotron 语音代理管道内工作，将访客所说的话转化为下一个适当的不情愿的答复。
博尔特提供了对话基础。我的提示、应用程序逻辑和 LoRA 适配器经过数千个经过审查的示例对话的训练，将其塑造成这艘特别顽固的船。
创建包含超过 5000 个多轮对话的数据集意味着我可以为每个我认为足够好的模型训练 LoRA。有些人花了大约一个小时来训练，有些人花了几个小时。当地代理运行了所有操作并对结果进行了基准测试。该代理和一个非常大的法学硕士首先创建并判断了数据集。这发生在晚上或我白天工作的时候。
LoRA 就位后，我会检查回复的连续性、时间和音调，基准模型和适配器的质量、重复性和速度，然后聆听表演。这座房子最终应该屈服，而不是变成一个令人愉快的看门人。一点点的抵抗也是魅力的一部分。与车库门无休止的争论并非如此。
两个快捷方式，两个输出。创作的文本会跳过新的对话生成，保存的音频会跳过合成。清晰的语音独立于观众效果来驱动动画。
如果他投诉时间过长，鬼屋就会失去权威。在整个答案完成之前，管道会发布可朗读的文本，因此房子可以在句子的其余部分仍在进行中时开始说话。准备好的问候语和糖果笑话涵盖了熟悉的遭遇：文本库保存了语言模型工作，缓存的录音保存了语音合成。即使是脾气暴躁的人也能从排练中受益。

NVIDIA Magpie TTS Zeroshot 将文本转换为女王英语。其零样本语音调节使用短参考样本而不是经过训练的语音；我的提供了脾气暴躁的海盗角色。该房子有七种情绪，从脾气暴躁和威胁到有趣和高兴，由提示模板决定并由法学硕士提供的情绪标签选择每行的交付方式。由于每种情绪都需要不同的 3-10 秒语音样本，因此我在 UI 的工具选项卡上添加了“采样您的语音”块。然后，我可以用我最快乐的海盗或愤怒的海盗声音阅读并记录一行示例文本。当“开始”时间到时，Bolt E4B 决定要说什么，Magpie 将文本转化为带有适当的喜悦或绝望的语音。

接下来是 Audio2Face-3D 和我在 Epic 的虚幻引擎中创建的 3D 角色场景。默认模型权重最适合干净、中性的男性或女性声音，不要太低沉，也不要太高（根据您的用例选择适当的性别模型）。我希望房子有一种非常低沉、恶魔般的声音，带有回声和室内乐。在这种情况下，由于我的声音样本没有那么戏剧化的分量，这实际上是一个好处。 Audio2Face-3D 从样本中获取清晰的语音，第二个音频流添加了可调节的实时声音效果，可在扬声器中播放。
为了让一切顺利运行，我将工作分配给一对 GPU：语言和语音模型管道在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 上运行，带有 Audio2Face-3D 的虚幻引擎图形在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 上运行。内存不是问题，计算才是问题。无论代理管道正在进行什么处理，我都希望动画保持一致的帧速率。
声音、动画和效果必须结合在一起。一个令人信服的怪物需要的不仅仅是快速的答案；它需要听起来好像投诉属于建筑物。就我而言，他确实如此。可以进行同步音频传输的调整。我发现我可以设置它们并忘记它们。 （100ms 补偿 Audio2Face-3D 缓冲）
一路走来，“让房子说话”需要一个充满控件的界面。我可以试听缓存的台词、调整开场气氛、跟随对话、更改语音处理并调整嘴巴动画。选项卡涵盖对话、模型选择、录音、提示、性能监控和摄像头反馈，音板和自定义对话字段让我可以把话放到他嘴里。还有模型加载控件和虚幻引擎连接指示器，因为有时怪物并不生闷气。他已断开连接。
MonsterHouse 控制台，带有音板、自定义线路、开场气氛和对话流程。
火焰和光芒也加入了这一行动。可编辑的规则将视觉提示与交付联系起来：现场提示从语音开始，而录制的表演可以遵循保存的时间线。我可以在不重建场景的情况下引导情绪的变化。
实时模式运行“不给糖就捣蛋”的角色。演示模式说服 The house 解释自己。麦克风模式让我可以直接在房子里说话，绕过识别、对话生成和语音合成。我干净的声音带动嘴巴；观众听到的是经过处理的版本。房子认为这是财产。我认为这是一个有用的后备。
NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 是一款为房屋提供视觉环境的 VLM。作为可选的观察者，它解释摄像机图像并描述可见的服装，以便角色有特定的反应。我不想重新发明每一个轮子，而是选择了流行的对象检测和跟踪模型 YOLO 和 ByteTrack 来对当前视野中的人员进行计数和跟踪。将这些工作分开，可以让观众注意到一个群体，而无需要求 Omni 叙述每一帧。
为了进行一个相当荒谬的测试，我给 Omni 播放了一段五只穿着戏服的绵羊在门口的视频。它保存的分析确定了海盗、吸血鬼、女巫、南瓜和幽灵服装。这就是我希望房子使用的视觉环境。显然，连牲畜都有比我更详尽的万圣节计划。
综合测试重播中的五个非常毛茸茸的“不给糖就捣蛋”游戏。服装标签来自保存的 Omni 分析；框和轨道 ID 是说明性的。
这些羊是一个综合测试，并不是万圣节之夜成功的证据。真实的车道组、服装和夜间照明仍需要测试。检测确实会触发自动问候，但我担心流行的服装识别和适当的机智反驳可能需要一些后期培训。由于房子没有眼睛，他称他的访客意识为回声定位。我让他拥有那个。
还有更多工作要做：动画总是可以改进，完整的性能测试需要真实的访问者，并且有一天会自动提供糖果。我还没有达到最初的目标，让他去经营万圣节，而我和家人一起去看其他邻居的食尸鬼。但这仍然是这一切的重点。有一天，一个孩子会遇到一栋脾气暴躁的老房子，尝试一点善意，就会发现这栋老木头也有柔软的地方。并分发棒棒糖。
MonsterHouse 代码本身并未打包发布，但它使用的每个 NVIDIA 模型现已可用，并且 NVIDIA Nemotron 语音代理可以帮助您实现大部分功能。这就是我要走的路。
缓存的响应库和为您最常用的台词保存的音频将使即使是缓慢的怪物也感觉很快。事实上，如果您碰巧受到计算能力的限制，那么您没有理由不能拥有一个仅使用 Nemotron 3 ASR（一个 Python 对话路由器）以及所有缓存音频的 Live 版本。您可以使用 Bolt E4B 和 Magpie 管道离线生成 100 个响应，然后使用缓存进行显示。我将为互动南瓜做这个。

Zest, the restaurant discovery app that launched earlier this year, is already thinking about a future where mobile apps are no longer the primary interface. On Thursday, the startup introduced a new feature: a personal AI-powered “restaurant concierge” that lives in your text messages, similar to other popular AI agents like Instinct or Poke.

The launch reflects a broader shift in how startups are thinking about AI, as conversational AI agents take on tasks that had previously required users to launch stand-alone mobile apps. For Zest, that means bringing its restaurant recommendations into texts, then allowing users to immediately take the next step of booking a table.

“The agent is the product now,” explains Zest founder and CEO Mario Gomez-Hall. “You text it, and it answers from your own history and your friends’. It doesn’t need weeks of conversation to learn you because it starts from where you’ve actually been,” he said.

Originally founded in November 2024, with $1.8 million in pre-seed backing from Alexis Ohanian at 776 and Steve Jang at Kindred Ventures, the app’s unique feature is that it links up with users’ credit cards to track where they’re actually eating out to get a sense of their tastes and interests. With this data on hand, Zest can make tailored suggestions of what places you might like to try next, whether that’s in your own city or suggestions of places to try when you’re traveling.

The credit card data used by Zest’s app is imported via the financial services company Plaid, which is used by banks and other fintech and budgeting apps. Zest says it focuses only on those transactions in the food and drink categories when making its personalized map and lists.

The startup’s latest idea is to tackle the same problem — where should I go to eat? — from a new angle. It will now make its suggestions from inside a text message thread and can turn to AI to do things like check availability and make the reservation for you through connected services like OpenTable, Resy, and SevenRooms.

To work, users will text the Zest concierge at (212) 470-6067. What’s even better is that Zest can be dropped into a group chat, where it can blend everyone’s tastes to find places the whole group will love. Here, it can also settle indecision with an in-thread voting feature and then can book a table for the group without leaving the conversation.

Users can ask Zest for recommendations based on a number of factors, like cuisine, craving, occasion, dietary restrictions, or neighborhood, and can ask questions about the restaurants, like how busy the place may be, or whether it offers Wi-Fi, and more. Plus, you can ask Zest to send you the menu to help you make a decision.

In TechCrunch’s tests, the AI worked fairly well, offering a list of suggestions for new places matched to our tastes that also fit particular conditions, like time of day, party size, location, and other factors. While finding an open table is something other apps have offered for years, there’s a convenience factor in being able to just text back and forth about the various options and have it tell you the available booking times.

The company began testing the concierge last month, but decided to hold the launch until it could add the booking capabilities; over time, the startup is considering moving Zest beyond restaurants to offer recommendations for businesses, shopping, and more.
By shifting to texts, Zest hopes the company can scale beyond its initial thousands of users and generate revenue.

“Booking and ordering are the first revenue lines. Zest books your table through OpenTable or Resy today, with food ordering coming, and there are transactions there to participate in,” said Gomez-Hall. “The reason that gets interesting is that Zest learns your taste faster than a general assistant does, because it starts from where you’ve actually been instead of asking you questions. That’s worth something well beyond dinner,” he added.

Zest 是今年早些时候推出的餐厅发现应用程序，它已经在考虑移动应用程序不再是主要界面的未来。周四，这家初创公司推出了一项新功能：一个由人工智能驱动的个人“餐厅礼宾服务”，存在于你的短信中，类似于其他流行的人工智能代理，如 Instinct 或 Poke。
此次发布反映了初创公司对人工智能的思考方式发生了更广泛的转变，因为对话式人工智能代理承担了以前需要用户启动独立移动应用程序的任务。对于 Zest 来说，这意味着将其餐厅推荐写入文本中，然后允许用户立即进行下一步预订餐桌。
“现在代理就是产品，”Zest 创始人兼首席执行官 Mario Gomez-Hall 解释道。 “你发短信给它，它会根据你自己和朋友的历史进行回复。它不需要几周的对话来了解你，因为它从你实际去过的地方开始，”他说。

该应用程序最初成立于 2024 年 11 月，获得了 776 的 Alexis Ohanian 和 Kindred Ventures 的 Steve Jang 的 180 万美元的种子期前支持，其独特功能是它与用户的信用卡关联，跟踪他们实际外出就餐的地点，以了解他们的品味和兴趣。有了这些数据，Zest 就可以针对您下一步可能想去的地方提出量身定制的建议，无论是在您自己的城市，还是在您旅行时建议您尝试的地方。
Zest 应用程序使用的信用卡数据是通过金融服务公司 Plaid 导入的，银行和其他金融科技和预算应用程序都使用该公司。 Zest 表示，在制作个性化地图和清单时，它只关注食品和饮料类别的交易。
这家初创公司的最新想法是解决同样的问题——我应该去哪里吃饭？ ——从一个新的角度。现在，它可以在短信线程中提出建议，并可以利用人工智能来执行诸如检查可用性等操作，并通过 OpenTable、Resy 和 SevenRooms 等连接服务为您进行预订。
如需工作，用户可拨打 (212) 470-6067 给 Zest 礼宾部发短信。更好的是，Zest 可以加入群聊，在那里它可以融合每个人的口味，找到整个小组都会喜欢的地方。在这里，它还可以通过线程内投票功能来解决犹豫不决的问题，然后可以在不离开对话的情况下为小组预订餐桌。
用户可以根据多种因素（例如美食、渴望、场合、饮食限制或社区）向 Zest 寻求推荐，并且可以询问有关餐厅的问题，例如该地方有多繁忙，或者是否提供 Wi-Fi 等等。另外，您可以要求 Zest 向您发送菜单以帮助您做出决定。
在 TechCrunch 的测试中，人工智能运行得相当好，提供了一系列符合我们口味的新地点建议，这些建议也符合特定条件，如一天中的时间、聚会规模、地点和其他因素。虽然找到空位的桌子是其他应用程序多年来提供的服务，但有一个方便的因素是，只需来回发送有关各种选项的短信，并让它告诉您可用的预订时间。
